title: SSC Combined Graduate Level CGL Recruitment 2026 Exam Schedule for 12256 Post
vacancyDetails: 12,256 posts across ministries and departments, including Assistant Section Officer, Inspector, Assistant Enforcement Officer, Sub Inspector, Auditor, Accountant, Tax Assistant, Postal Assistant and other CGL posts.
qualification: Bachelor's degree from any recognized university in India for most posts. Junior Statistical Officer, Statistical Investigator Grade-II and Research Assistant posts have additional or post-specific eligibility conditions.
ageLimit: 18 to 27-32 years, post-wise, as on 01/08/2026. Age relaxation applies as per SSC CGL recruitment rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 100; SC / ST / PH and all category female candidates: Nil. Correction fee: Rs. 200 for first correction and Rs. 500 for second correction.
selectionProcess: Tier-I Computer Based Examination -> Tier-II Computer Based Examination -> Document Verification / Skill Test as applicable -> Final merit
documentsRequired: OTR details, educational certificates, identity proof, live photograph through webcam or SSC App, signature, category certificate where applicable and fee payment details.
howToApply:
1. Complete one-time registration on https://ssc.gov.in
2. Open SSC CGL 2026 and verify the notification
3. Fill the application form from 21/05/2026 to 25/06/2026
4. Upload the live photograph and required documents
5. Pay the fee if applicable and submit the form
6. Check the preview carefully and print the final application
shortDescription: SSC CGL Recruitment 2026 exam schedule released for 12,256 posts. Tier-I exam is scheduled from 30 September to 30 October 2026; check dates, eligibility, fees and official links.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the schedule and recruitment details for the Combined Graduate Level CGL Examination 2026 for 12,256 posts.

The application window was open from 21 May 2026 to 25 June 2026. The Tier-I Computer Based Examination is scheduled from 30 September to 30 October 2026, while the Tier-II examination is expected in December 2026.

Important dates

  • Application begins: 21/05/2026
  • Last date to apply: 25/06/2026 up to 11 PM
  • Online fee payment last date: 26/06/2026
  • Correction window: 01 to 07 July 2026
  • Tier-I exam: 30 September to 30 October 2026
  • Tier-II exam: December 2026
  • Admit card: Before the examination

Eligibility overview

Most SSC CGL posts require a bachelor's degree from a recognized university. Junior Statistical Officer, Statistical Investigator Grade-II and Research Assistant posts carry additional or post-specific conditions. Read the official notification for the complete post-wise eligibility, age limits and department details.

Use the official SSC website and the exam schedule link below for authentic notices, admit card updates and application information.
